reason: The first live assembly proved the technical pipeline, but the artwork drifted from the approved OPAIJA character bible/model sheets, some clips contained generated text or lettering artifacts, action motion was too weak, and the narration sounded robotic.
blockers: Storyboard art must match the approved character sheets, especially Kai's black sleeveless hoodie, red/orange sash, detailed Listening Bois, beads/wraps, pendant, skin tone, silhouette, and ink-heavy OPAIJA model-sheet style.
Artwork and clips with lettering, signs, fake logos, subtitles, labels, or poster text must be rejected before animation.
Action scenes must be generated from start/end action frames or multi-reference boards, not a single static poster frame.
Voiceover must be a directed performance pass with emotion, pauses, and Caribbean cadence notes, not a generic scratch narration.
nextBuildRules: Use approved model-sheet image files as real visual references, not only text names in the prompt.
Create action-pair frames for every combat, transformation, reveal, and power beat: first pose, impact pose, recovery pose where needed.
Run visual QC on every artwork frame before Seedance: style match, character match, no lettering, readable action, readable weapon, no costume drift.
Only send QC-approved storyboard frames to Seedance.
Use a human-directed voice map or a stronger ElevenLabs performance prompt before final assembly.

currentArtifacts.purpose: Internal preview only. Use for diagnosing pipeline failures, not marketing or release.
